purpose: Optional occasion menus; choosing one proposes a meal, not a booking or played event.

menus.name: Christmas lunch
menus.notes: A full festive lunch, scaled to the household and guests actually present. Baking, puddings and staffing are planned in advance.

menu.starter: Smoked salmon, rye blinis, dill and crème fraîche; beetroot and horseradish on blinis as the vegetarian starter.
menu.main: Roast turkey with chestnut and sage stuffing, pigs in blankets, bread sauce, cranberry sauce and turkey gravy.
menu.alongside: Roast potatoes, parsnips, carrots, Brussels sprouts and braised red cabbage; vegetarian portions cooked separately.
menu.dessert: Christmas pudding with brandy butter or vanilla custard; clementines and mince pies with coffee.
menu.vegetarian: Mushroom, chestnut and lentil Wellington with vegetable gravy, vegetarian stuffing and the same separately cooked vegetables. Vegetarian-suet Christmas pudding.
menu.with_drinks: Gougères, olives and spiced nuts; still/sparkling water and blackcurrant cordial, with wine when wanted.

menus.name: Boxing Day table
menus.notes: A flexible shared table. Use a freshly prepared pie filling when suitable leftovers are unavailable.

menu.main: Freshly baked ham with mustard and pickles; a turkey and leek pie where properly stored Christmas turkey is available.
menu.alongside: Winter slaw, warm potatoes with chives, sourdough and a beetroot-and-lentil salad.
menu.dessert: Pear and almond tart; clementines and Christmas cake.
menu.vegetarian: Mushroom, leek and white-bean pie; the same soup made with vegetable stock, salads and potatoes.
menu.with_drinks: Cheese straws, olives, water and chilled house cordial.

menus.name: New Year’s Eve dinner
menus.notes: A seated dinner with a separately planned late-night snack of cheese toasties. Midnight service is arranged with rota cover.

menu.starter: Crab with apple, cucumber and dill; beetroot, apple and lentils as the vegetarian starter.
menu.main: Beef fillet with red-wine shallot sauce.
menu.alongside: Potato gratin, glazed carrots and winter greens.
menu.dessert: Dark-chocolate délice, poached pear and vanilla cream; petits fours with coffee.
menu.vegetarian: Mushroom and chestnut pithivier with vegetable-stock shallot sauce; vegetarian-set chocolate dessert.
menu.with_drinks: Warm gougères and smoked-salmon tartlets; mushroom tartlets for vegetarians. Water and house cordial throughout; Champagne or wine if wanted.

menus.name: Easter Sunday lunch
menus.notes: A spring celebration menu available whenever selected; it does not establish where Alex spends Easter.

menu.starter: Pea and mint soup with crème fraîche.
menu.main: Slow-roast lamb shoulder with rosemary jus.
menu.alongside: Roast potatoes, buttered carrots, peas and spring cabbage.
menu.dessert: Rhubarb and almond tart with vanilla ice cream; small chocolate truffles with coffee.
menu.vegetarian: Mushroom, leek and lentil pie with rosemary vegetable gravy and separately cooked vegetables.
menu.with_drinks: Radishes, olives and cheese sablés; water, elderflower-and-lemon cordial and wine if wanted.

menus.name: Summer garden party
menus.notes: A scalable party menu. Larger gatherings require an agreed event team and service plan; choosing this menu does not book the garden or fix a guest count.

menu.starter: Tomatoes, basil and burrata; tomato, white-bean and herb salad as the dairy-free alternative.
menu.main: Lemon-and-thyme roast chicken with tarragon sauce, served on sharing platters.
menu.alongside: New potatoes, grilled courgettes, green beans and rosemary focaccia.
menu.dessert: Lemon tart, raspberries and vanilla ice cream.
menu.vegetarian: Roast aubergine with white beans, tomatoes and herbs; the same potatoes, vegetables and bread.
menu.with_drinks: Tomato tartlets, crab toast and mushroom arancini; water, Cream Soda and chilled house cordials.

menus.name: Celebration dinner
menus.notes: An adaptable private-house celebration menu, with the cake and dietary needs agreed for the actual guests.

menu.starter: Roast beetroot with goat’s cheese, walnuts and herb dressing.
menu.main: Roast chicken with a rich tarragon sauce.
menu.alongside: Potato gratin and seasonal vegetables: spring greens, summer beans, autumn carrots or winter cabbage.
menu.dessert: A chocolate celebration cake with vanilla ice cream; the inscription is chosen for the occasion.
menu.vegetarian: Mushroom and lentil pithivier with tarragon vegetable sauce; vegetarian goat’s cheese in the starter.
menu.with_drinks: Gougères and olives; still/sparkling water, house cordial and wine when wanted.
